# Isaiah Chapter 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:14** Therefore the-Lord himself will-give yitten to-you a-sign ot: Behold, the-young-woman ha-almah is pregnant harah and-bearing veyoledet a-son ben, and-she-will-call veqarat his-name Immanu-El God-With-Us.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 7 — "The Sign of Immanuel" — rendered in formal English preserving the Hebrew prophetic structure.

*— LOGOS*
